docs-scene3d-ci.description: Docs route under CI software rasterization with lazy WebGL fallback preserved. Bounded WebGL instanced-shadow slice passed 1575 JS tests, focused Go tests, and 231 real native browser cases. Isolated perf gate measured JS 1308.25KiB (<= 1550), network 1536.158203125KiB, LCP 1996ms (<= 18000), TBT 1518ms (<= 15000); only network exceeded the prior 1531KiB cap, so the cap moves to 1537KiB — the next integer KiB above the measured 1536.158203125KiB payload. The exact measured network increase versus last tested HEAD is 5869 bytes (scene3d shared feature +1088, WebGL feature +4781). Timing gates remain passing and unchanged. Fresh remote CI on this head is pending; no hardware certification is implied.

water-ci.description: Water route under CI software rasterization. Gates load, the reviewed O-series browser-host and runtime payload, and total blocking time; long-task count is intentionally ungated because continuous software-raster frames straddle the 50ms boundary. Real-GPU cadence is certified separately. The latest remote CI browser run (head 4565844d, run 33177437376, completed successfully) measured 1672.54KiB network payload with timing gates passing; this WebGL instanced-shadow slice adds 1088 bytes to the shared scene3d feature that water loads (1088/1024 = 1.0625KiB), projecting ~1673.6025KiB — beyond the current 1673KiB cap — so the assertion moves to 1674KiB as the narrow integer-KiB ceiling over the projected remote payload. Fresh remote CI on this head is pending; the projection is derived from a remote measurement plus a known byte increment, not a physical-GPU certification.
